source.symbol: add_custom_command(

rows.contract: Host shader output follows selected SDK and configured deployment parameters.
rows.native_mapping: Resolve xcrun and the effective SDK path. Invoke the real Apple metal compiler with -std=metal4.0 and DEPFILE.
rows.expected_result: Compiler builds MSL4 asset that file identifies as a MetalLib executable. The dependency file points to its input headers.
rows.command: python3 docs/metaliris/003/verify.py <scratch-dir>
rows.actual_result: Fixture passed, including a dependency-triggered rebuild and recovery. See build.log.

source.symbol: MAIN_DEPENDENCY

rows.contract: Shader build inputs, included files and generated outputs need precise invalidation.
rows.native_mapping: Each shader has its own binary/output header and compiler depfile; code generation itself is a packaging dependency.
rows.expected_result: No-op build performs no work, identical rebuild produces identical bytes, and changing only an include regenerates the affected output.
rows.command: python3 docs/metaliris/003/verify.py <scratch-dir>
rows.actual_result: Fixture passed, including a dependency-triggered rebuild and recovery. See build.log.

source.symbol: DEPENDS

rows.contract: Invalid source should fail the build and recovery should use the corrected inputs.
rows.native_mapping: Use native compiler errors and atomic packaging writes with no fallback shader.
rows.expected_result: Malformed transitive include fails with its original diagnostic, and reverting it rebuilds the valid artifact.
rows.command: python3 docs/metaliris/003/verify.py <scratch-dir>
rows.actual_result: Fixture passed, including a dependency-triggered rebuild and recovery. See build.log.

source.symbol: ${SHADER_HEADERS}

rows.contract: Executable shader outputs are verified with real production assets by their separate owners.
rows.native_mapping: After the first shader owner completes, reopen 003, register it and verify artifact generation and native pipeline use.
rows.expected_result: Every real shader is independently compiled, built and consumed. GPU output follows each owner fixture and the device trigger.
rows.command: python3 docs/metaliris/003/verify.py <scratch-dir>
rows.actual_result: 19 real packed MSL4 assets and full consumer link verified. Physical pipeline creation, shader execution and pixel/oracle fixture remain pending.
